reviews.title: Great 850w Power Supply Unit Highly Recommend
reviews.comment: This is a great power supply handled my Ryzen 5 7500F and RTX 5070 Ti with a ton fans and aio. Also has the 12v-2x6 ATX 3.1 connector for my GPU which is nice as well. No problems at all the smart zero fan mode is also nice so it doesn't come on at low loads when it doesn't need to. Cables are nice as well and the psu is nice and compact so it was easy to install in my case which is the Montech XR. It is much better compared to my older unit I use to have it will also allow me to get stronger upgrades for PC parts in future if you need to.

reviews.title: Thermaltake Toughpower GT 850W Review: ATX 3.1 Ready PSU for Gaming & RTX Builds 🔥
reviews.comment: The Thermaltake Toughpower GT 850W is a modern 80+ Gold fully modular PSU designed for high-performance gaming PCs and next-gen GPUs. It follows the ATX 3.1 standard, which means it’s ready for newer graphics cards thanks to the native 12V-2x6 (PCIe 5.1) connector. This helps deliver stable power during sudden GPU spikes, which is important for RTX 40/50 series builds.
